reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness attachment upload, file-card rendering, document text extraction, session-scoped file handling, and optional external OCR for scanned PDFs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持拖拽上传、文件卡片展示以及 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、TXT 等文档文本提取的附件功能。
summaries.en: Adds DeepSeek Harness attachments with drag-and-drop uploads, file cards, and text extraction for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, and related files.

capabilities: extracts text from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, Markdown, and code files
stores uploaded files in session-specific host directories
renders attachment cards in chat messages
can send scanned PDF pages to a configurable external vision OCR service
